## Requirement ids

- **SIG-TRANSP-014 (owner, MUST)** — the downloads listing per release: every file with licence, attribution, byte size, row count, sha256, format.
- **SIG-TRANSP-015 (owner, MUST)** — per-bundle `ATTRIBUTION.txt`/`LICENCE.txt`; a required-but-empty attribution refuses loudly.
- **SIG-TRANSP-018 (owner, MUST)** — `SHA256SUMS` over every manifest member + `manifest.json`, plus the detached pipeline minisign signature (`SHA256SUMS.minisig` + `sig-release.minisign.pub`) when the OP-20 key is provisioned; `unsigned` declared otherwise.
- **SIG-REL-015** — the pipeline minisign key under OP-20 custody (integrity, never approval): pure-Python Ed25519 + the byte-compatible minisign container; `SIG_RELEASE_MINISIGN_SECRET` env, never a repo file; key creation is operator action → `D-P36.50-1`.
- Cited: **SIG-UI-082** (linked, never inlined metadata), **SIG-ENG-042**, ADR-155 (`/data/` + `/data/api/` T1; `/releases/*/data/**` T0).
- Carried verbatim: **`D-J3-5 [A-8] = b`** (no withdrawal — captured terms + operator-accepted basis per bundle; corrected by a new release, never retracted silently), **`D-J3-8 [B-20] = a`** (checksums + pipeline minisign), **`A-3 = a`** (R2-host content-hash links), **`D-J3-7`** (linked metadata only).
- **K9 C-8** — the per-source statements slice ships beside the sites slice (`by-source/<id>/statements.jsonl.gz`).

## What lands

- `exports/minisign.py` — dependency-free Ed25519 (RFC 8032 vectors pinned) + minisign public-key/secret/detached-signature formats.
- `exports/downloads.py` — per-source slices (sites + statements + ATTRIBUTION/LICENCE), per-compartment `ATTRIBUTION.txt`/`LICENCE.txt`, `SHA256SUMS`, `write_integrity_files`, `verify_downloads` (`sig.download-verify/1`), and the `sig.download-listing/1` document with R2-host content-hash hrefs and the mirror/signature blocks.
- `spine_export.py` — slice + txt emission from the compartment-attribution payload; `web/downloads.json` manifest-listed and dictionary-documented; `download_signing`/`mirror_registry_path` seams; `write_to(signing_secret_b64=…)`.
- `release.py` + `release_pages.py` — the immutable `/releases/<pub>/data/` (bound listing + T0 page + bound integrity copies); `data*` routes join `EXTERNAL_LINK_ROUTES`.
- `cli.py` — `sig-exports downloads verify --in <dir>`; `build` signs when `SIG_RELEASE_MINISIGN_SECRET` is provisioned.
- `push.py` — the mirror push carries the integrity side files at content-hash keys.
- Web: `lib/downloads.ts` + fixture + `getDownloadListing()`; `/data/` downloads center; `/data/api/` docs; page-types rows.
- Tests: `tests/exports/test_minisign.py` (7) + `test_downloads.py` (8) + `web/tests/unit/downloads.test.ts` (6). `copy-batches/batch-11.md` — 11 pending rows. `DEFERRALS.md` — `D-P36.50-1`.
